src/cli.ts.name: kehto paja command
src/cli.ts.description: Reads the command's flags and config file, starts the napplet's own dev command if given, waits for the target, then starts the Paja server.

src/config-file.ts.name: Config file loader
src/config-file.ts.description: Loads a JSON Paja config file from disk and merges it with flags given on the command line, flags winning.

src/host-page.ts.name: Host page
src/host-page.ts.description: Builds the HTML of the Paja page: top bar, collapsible sidebar sections, approval and LLM dialogs, frame policy and the embedded host config for the browser code.

src/node-compat.d.ts.name: Node type stand-ins
src/node-compat.d.ts.description: Declares the few Node built-ins (HTTP server, files, child processes, DNS) Paja uses so it type-checks without full Node types.

src/readiness.ts.name: Wait for dev server
src/readiness.ts.description: Polls the target URL every 250 ms until it answers without a server error, or gives up after the configured timeout with the last failure.

src/server-resource-transport.ts.name: Pinned resource fetch
src/server-resource-transport.ts.description: Fetches one web address for a napplet after pinning its public IP right after the DNS lookup, never following redirects.

src/server.ts.name: Paja local server
src/server.ts.description: Serves the host page, the browser bundle and the resource proxy on a loopback port, checks the target's CORS and plans its network mode.

src/target-cors.ts.name: Dev-server CORS check
src/target-cors.ts.description: Probes whether the target dev server accepts the sandboxed frame's null origin and explains the fix, and lists the exact origins a live target's frame may load from.

tsup.config.ts.name: Build setup
tsup.config.ts.description: Builds the Node entry points and, separately, the self-contained browser-host.js bundle with all Kehto and napplet code inlined.
